content: गोलः, -ला, -लम् [गुड् अच् डस्य लः] .²1 A ball, globe; कदम्बगोलाकृतिमाश्रितः कथम् <ls>Māl. 7. 1</ls>. .²2 The celestial or terrestrial globe. .²3 A circle. .²4 A sphere, anything round or globular. .{@-लः@} .²1 A widowʼs bastard; <ab>cf.</ab> कुण्ड; <ls>Y. 1. 222</ls>. .²2 The conjunction of several planets or the presence of several in one sign. .²3 Myrrh. .{@-ला@} .²1 A wooden ball with which children play. .²2 A large globular water-jar. .²3 Red arsenic. .²4 Ink. .²5 A womanʼs female friend. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of the river Godāvari.
